name: qanet_latency
title: OS-QANET D4: the latency budgets of the host test (preview first sound, the preview of a long clip, the cursor move while F5 is held, the screen switch, the File and Sample load listings) measured on the unit; every measured step is soft, it gates nothing

steps.say: OS-QANET D4 (docs/specs/OS-QANET.md section 7, Q1): the latency budgets of tests/qanet/budgets.cpp on the unit. It GATES NOTHING: every measured step is soft, so one run prints all the numbers. Each measured step is `within` the budget; the number to write down is that step's `seconds` in the --report (about 10 ms resolution; the key's own round trip is not in it). Card: the four qanet_ clips in the card root, and the large card for the listings (README.md of this folder). Read-only: it writes nothing to the card.
preview.first_sound: F5 held on a 1 s mono clip; budget 150 ms to the first voice

steps.note: the listing is there (an entry is under the cursor); the cursor is on its first entry
down to qanet_1_short.wav by name (the cursor is on the first entry; the clips are consecutive in the listing)
no voice before the key: a voice still ringing would pass the first-sound step at once
MEASURED from here: the key, then `voices` polled every 10 ms until a voice is in use (the engine has started the preview: the sound follows within one block, about 1.5 ms)
preview.first_sound: first sound within 150 ms
and it is heard on the USB capture (a level check: the capture starts after the key, it is no timestamp)
the preview stops when F5 is let go

steps.say: preview.long_clip: F5 held on a 6 s stereo clip: the preview streams, it does not wait for the whole clip; budget 150 ms to the first voice

steps.note: the listing is there (an entry is under the cursor); the cursor is on its first entry
down to qanet_2_long.wav by name (the cursor is on the first entry; the clips are consecutive in the listing)
no voice before the key: a voice still ringing would pass the first-sound step at once
MEASURED from here: the key, then `voices` polled every 10 ms until a voice is in use (the engine has started the preview: the sound follows within one block, about 1.5 ms)
preview.long_clip: first sound within 150 ms
and it is heard on the USB capture (a level check: the capture starts after the key, it is no timestamp)
the preview stops when F5 is let go

steps.say: preview.cursor_move: F5 held on qanet_3_tone_a.wav (210 Hz), then one step down to qanet_4_tone_b.wav (882 Hz); budget 150 ms from the move to the new file's first sound

steps.note: the listing is there (an entry is under the cursor); the cursor is on its first entry
down to qanet_3_tone_a.wav by name (the cursor is on the first entry; the clips are consecutive in the listing)
no voice before the key: a voice still ringing would pass the first-sound step at once
the first file sounds (not a budget: the move is made while it plays)
MEASURED from here. `voices` cannot tell the old file from the new: the old voice is expected to stop (step 1), the new to start (step 2); the move's number is the two steps' seconds added
1: the old file's voice has stopped (fails when the old voice went on, or when the new one began inside the first poll: read it with the next steps)
2: a voice is in use again: the new file began (budget: steps 1 and 2 together within 150 ms)
the cursor is on the new file
the new file is what sounds (882 Hz); a silence or 210 Hz here is the finding of the host (OS-BUG-PREVLAT: the move stops the audition)
